verdict.rationale: Edit-run loop speed is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about script hot reload, domain or assembly reload behavior, or instant Play-mode preview after a code change. Marketing lines like "iterate quickly with your team" and "real time" are generic slogans, not documentation of this capability.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change
